title: Project templates
no_workspace: Open a workspace to see the project templates it offers.
about: What a new project may start from here. A template is optional and only fills in the New project card: the project's sources, a brief, the kits ticked, and which tabs its projects show. What the product is, is not a template's to say: Studio proposes it from the project's specs. Showing {source}. Projects already created keep their tabs; one whose template is removed shows every tab.
source_organization: the list of {org}, which every workspace of it inherits
source_builtin: Studio's built-in templates: neither this workspace nor its organization has set any
offer_none_hint: Offer no template: every project starts empty
none_offered: No template is offered: every new project starts empty.
description_placeholder: One line the New project card shows under the title
brief_placeholder: A brief the card starts with (optional): what a project from this template builds
dropped: This workspace now uses what it inherits.
nothing_stored: Nothing is stored until you save.
